workflows.name: Look up a city on Wikipedia and add its key facts to Notes
steps: In the Wikipedia tab, click the search box, type "{city}" and press Enter
On the article, find the population and country in the infobox (scroll if needed)
Click the "New note" field, type "{city}: population <the number you saw>, <country>" and press Enter

workflows.name: Convert an amount on xe.com and log the rate in Notes
steps: In the xe.com tab, click the Amount field, clear it and type {amount}
Click the From currency field, type {from} and pick it from the list
Click the To currency field, type {to} and pick it from the list
Click Convert and read the result
Switch to the Notes tab, click "New note", type "{amount} {from} = <the result> {to}" and press Enter

workflows.name: Find a book on Open Library and draft an email recommending it
steps: In the Open Library tab, click the search box, type "{title}" and press Enter
Open the first matching result and note the author and first publish year
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type {email}
Click Body and type "Hi {friend}, you might like {title} by <author> (<year>)."
Do not click Send. Click Discard to clear the draft

W1.2.note: In step 1, first type "Krakw", notice the typo, fix it to "Kraków", then press Enter
